reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Ceramide Essential Mask Sheet Moisture Barrier 4ea
reviews.text: It adheres well to the skin and was easy to use. My skin was moist after use, and I didn't worry about dryness. The scent isn't too strong, and it's easy to use. I would like to buy it again.
reviews.zh: 貼皮貼得好好，用起嚟好方便。用完之後皮膚濕潤，唔使擔心乾燥。香味唔會太濃，而且用起嚟好易。我想再買。

reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Ceramide Essential Mask Sheet Moisture Barrier 4ea
reviews.text: So good results for aging skin! Highly recommend to try this mask, specially!! if you’re looking for a nature glow, I highly recommend you!
reviews.zh: 對於老化皮膚，效果好好！特別推薦試吓呢款面膜！！如果你想要自然光澤，我好推薦你！

reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Ceramide Essential Mask Sheet Moisture Barrier 4ea
reviews.text: Unfortunately, there’s some ingredient in this that my skin reacts to. Not necessarily the masks fault but I’m tired of brands not being extra careful with their ingredients, especially when they claim to have done testing on sensitive skin. It seems like a quality mask just doesn’t work for me. Also, it was more of a lotion consistency instead of a serum which might clog pores for some people.
reviews.zh: 可惜，呢款入面有啲成分我嘅皮膚會有反應。未必係面膜嘅問題，但係我真係好唔滿意有啲品牌唔夠謹慎處理成分，尤其係佢哋聲稱有做過敏感肌測試嘅時候。睇落好似優質面膜就係唔啱我。另外，佢質地比較似乳液，而唔係精華，可能會令到一啲人嘅毛孔堵塞。

reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Ceramide Essential Mask Sheet Moisture Barrier 4ea
reviews.text: I have bought this with Mediheal NMF and Mediheal Rose PDRN masks, this one is not the best one but still not bad, quite nourishing!
reviews.zh: 我係同 Mediheal NMF 同 Mediheal Rose PDRN 面膜一齊買嘅，呢款唔係最好嗰款，但都唔錯，幾滋養！

reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Ceramide Essential Mask Sheet Moisture Barrier 4ea
reviews.text: Love the creaminess of this mask. Not your typical gel/water like liquid. This is more milky and soft
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款面膜嘅綿密質地。唔似一般嗰啲啫喱或者水狀嘅質感，佢更似奶狀，幼滑柔軟。

reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Ceramide Essential Mask Sheet Moisture Barrier 4ea
reviews.text: This mask is amazing! It gives my skin deep hydration, makes it feel soft and smooth, and adds a nice bounce and elasticity. After using it, my skin looks healthier and more refined. I’ll definitely repurchase!
reviews.zh: 呢款面膜好正！深層補水，令皮膚感覺柔軟順滑，又令皮膚有好好嘅彈潤感同彈性。用完之後，皮膚睇落更健康、更細緻。我一定會再買！

reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Ceramide Essential Mask Sheet Moisture Barrier 4ea
reviews.text:
• シートは柔らかく肌にしっかり密着します。
 • 美容液はたっぷりですがベタつかず、肌にすっとなじみます。
 • 使用後は肌がしっとり潤って、もっちりとした仕上がりになりました。
 • 刺激やかゆみなどは一切ありませんでした。
reviews.zh:
• 面膜紙柔軟，能夠好好貼服皮膚。
 • 精華液好多，但唔會黏，即刻滲入皮膚。
 • 用完之後皮膚濕潤，有煙韌彈潤嘅效果。
 • 完全冇刺激或者痕癢等情況。

reviews.shade: MEDIHEAL Ceramide Essential Mask Sheet Moisture Barrier 4ea
reviews.text:
Intense Hydration and Barrier Repair
This mask contains four types of ceramides (NP, AP, EOP, NS), processed with liposomal technology for deep and rapid penetration. It also includes soothing ingredients like panthenol and ectoine, for hydration that lasts up to 24 hours without leaving a greasy feeling.
reviews.zh:
強效補水同修護屏障
呢款面膜含有四種神經醯胺（NP、AP、EOP、NS），採用脂質體技術加工，令滲透深入而迅速。佢亦含有泛醇同依克多因（ectoine）等舒緩成分，補水效果可維持達 24 小時，而且唔會留低油膩感。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
